extracted.intended_audience: Users of GAP (mathematicians, computational algebraists, and programmers using GAP)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference for creating, testing, comparing, and manipulating words, free magmas/monoids/groups, and their representations in GAP; includes properties and operations for associative and nonassociative words and related magma operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfMagmaWithOne(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: is a list gens of elements of the magma-with-one M that generates M as a magma-with-one, that is, the closure of gens under multiplication * and One is M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For a free magma with one, each generator can also be accessed using the . operator. Use GeneratorsOfMagmaWithOne to obtain generators; the closure under multiplication and One should equal M.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfMagmaWithInverses(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: is a list gens of elements of the magma-with-inverses M that generates M as a magma-with-inverses, i.e., the closure of gens under multiplication * and taking inverses is M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators generate the structure when closed under multiplication and Inverse. Use when the domain supports inverses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralizer(M, elm) / Centralizer(M, S) / Centralizer(class)
rubrics_metrics.description: For an element elm, returns the domain of elements of M that commute with elm. For a submagma S, returns elements that commute with all s in S. For a class (with ActingDomain stored), returns the centralizer of Representative(class).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to compute commuting subdomains. Examples show Group centralizers; Centralizer(g,Subgroup(g,[...])) returns subgroup generated by the commuting element(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Centre(M) / Center(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: Centre returns the centre of the magma M: the domain of elements m in M that commute and associate with all elements of M (formal condition {m ∈ M; ∀a,b ∈ M: ma = am, (ma)b = m(ab), (am)b = a(mb), (ab)m = a(bm)}). Center is a synonym.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For associative magmas Centre(M) = Centralizer(M, M). The centre is always commutative; when implementing a new method for Centre, set IsCommutative of the result to true.

rubrics_metrics.name: Idempotents(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: The set of elements of M which are their own squares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute listing idempotent elements (e such that e*e = e). No further scoring notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAssociative(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: Property: M is associative if for all a,b,c in M we have (a*b)*c = a*(b*c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associative magma = semigroup; associative magma-with-one = monoid; associative magma-with-inverses = group. Use IsAssociative to test associativity of a multiplication structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCentral(M, obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsCentral returns true if obj (element or magma) commutes with all elements in the magma M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to test whether a given object is central in M.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCommutative(M) / IsAbelian(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: Property: M is commutative if for all a,b in M, a*b = b*a. IsAbelian is a synonym of IsCommutative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For additive structures use IsAdditivelyCommutative. Use to check commutativity; e.g., centre results should set IsCommutative true.

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicativeNeutralElement(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: returns the element e in M with property e*m = m = m*e for all m in M, if such exists; otherwise fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A magma that is not formally a magma-with-one may still have a multiplicative neutral element e, but then e is not One(M).

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicativeZero(M) / IsMultiplicativeZero(M, z)
rubrics_metrics.description: MultiplicativeZero returns the element z such that z*m = m*z = z for all m in M. IsMultiplicativeZero returns true if z equals the multiplicative zero of M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows MultiplicativeZero may return fail or a Transformation. Use IsMultiplicativeZero to test an element.

rubrics_metrics.name: SquareRoots(M, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: is the proper set of all elements r in M such that r * r = elm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns all square roots of a given element; used in magma contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TrivialSubmagmaWithOne(M)
rubrics_metrics.description: is the magma-with-one whose only element is the identity of M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructs the trivial submagma-with-one containing only the identity of M.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWord(obj) / IsWordWithOne(obj) / IsWordWithInverse(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories: A word is any expression of an element in a free multiplicative structure M (free semigroups, monoids, groups, free magmas). IsWord is a common roof for IsAssocWord and IsNonassocWord.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements in free magmas are IsWord; words are constants (not copyable/mutable). Use IsWord to test membership in word categories; associative and nonassociative words are treated separately for external representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWordCollection(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsWordCollection is the collections category of IsWord.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to test whether a collection is a collection of words (example: IsWordCollection(["a","b"]) returns false).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNonassocWord(obj) / IsNonassocWordWithOne(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: A nonassociative word is an element in a free magma or free magma-with-one. ViewObj/PrintObj show nonassociative words with round brackets indicating multiplication order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nonassociative words describe a 'program' to form a product of generators; use MappedWord to apply such a program. Associative words are NOT regarded as special cases of nonassociative words.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNonassocWordCollection / IsNonassocWordWithOneCollection
rubrics_metrics.description: Collections categories of IsNonassocWord and IsNonassocWordWithOne respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to IsWordCollection but for nonassociative words.

rubrics_metrics.name: \=(w1, w2) (for nonassociative words)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two words are equal iff they are words over the same alphabet and have equal external representations; for nonassociative words this means same sequence of multiplications (same external representation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equality checks depend on family/alphabet identity — words from different FreeMagma calls are not equal even if printed the same.

rubrics_metrics.name: \<(w1, w2) (for nonassociative words)
rubrics_metrics.description: Orders words according to their external representation; only comparable if words are over the same alphabet. For nonassociative words ordering is as defined in 36.5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to compare words; the alphabet is determined by the family. Words from different families are not comparable.

rubrics_metrics.name: MappedWord(w, gens, imgs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the object obtained by replacing each occurrence in word w of a generator in gens by the corresponding object in imgs; lists gens and imgs must have same length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preprocessing is needed; mapping many words may be slower than a dedicated loop. If imgs are associative words in same family, omit identities to be more efficient. For free groups, you may provide inverses as extra gens to speed up mapping. Use EliminatedWord when mapping only one generator replacement frequently.

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeMagma(...)
rubrics_metrics.description: FreeMagma returns a free magma. Several calling forms specify rank and generator labels: rank with optional name prefix, specified generator names, list of names, or infinity for infinitely many generators with optional name and init list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generator labels are for printing only and may not distinguish generators. Options: generatorNames option respected; for infinity rank, labels init followed by namei. Examples show usage and GeneratorsOfMagma to access generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeMagmaWithOne(...)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a free magma-with-one with similar calling forms to FreeMagma but rank can be zero and One exists; generator labelling rules analogous to FreeMagma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: labels are for printing only. For rank infinity, similar labelling rules. FreeMagmaWithOne(0) returns <free group of rank zero> (i.e., trivial group).

rubrics_metrics.name: External representation for nonassociative words (36.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines external representation: i-th generator has representation i, identity 0, inverse -i, and product v*w has representation [ev, ew]; thus external rep is integer or nested lists of integers and lists where each list has length two.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ObjByExtRep can create a nonassociative word from external representation; ExtRepOfObj returns external rep. External reps reflect exact parenthesization.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAssocWord(obj) / IsAssocWordWithOne(obj) / IsAssocWordWithInverse(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories: associative words in free semigroups (IsAssocWord), free monoids (IsAssocWordWithOne), and free groups (IsAssocWordWithInverse).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associative words represent sequences of letters; categories used for type checks and to distinguish allowed operations (One, Inverse).

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeGroup(...)
rubrics_metrics.description: FreeGroup returns a free group. Calling forms allow specifying rank/name(s)/names list/infinity; optional first argument wfilt selects internal representation (IsSyllableWordsFamily, IsLetterWordsFamily, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generator labels are printing aids. If wfilt omitted, letter representation used. Option FreeGroupFamilyType can be set to 'syllable' for older code compatibility. Examples show generator access and infinite generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFreeGroup(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter: any group whose elements are IsAssocWordWithInverse lies in IsFreeGroup (e.g., groups created with FreeGroup or subgroups thereof).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to test freeness of group objects in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: AssignGeneratorVariables(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: If G is a group whose generators are represented by symbols, assigns these generators to global variables with the same names (shorthand for var1 := GeneratorsOfGroup(G)[1]; ...).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for interactive use. Not permitted within a function; overwriting variables gives warnings, write-protected variables or invalid names raise errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: \=(w1, w2) (for associative words)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two associative words are equal if they are words over the same alphabet and are sequences of the same letters; equivalent to equal external representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family/alphabet identity matters: no universal empty word; every family has its own empty word.

rubrics_metrics.name: \<(w1, w2) (for associative words)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ordering of associative words is short-lex: shorter words are smaller; among same length compare lexicographically by generator ordering. Generators sorted by creation order; if generators are invertible, g > g^-1, and g^-1 > any generator smaller than g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to compare words under short-lex. Examples show comparisons involving inverses and identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsShortLexLessThanOrEqual(u, v)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns IsLessThanOrEqualUnder(ord, u, v) where ord is the short less ordering for the family of u and v (compatibility helper).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compatibility function for older GAP versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBasicWreathLessThanOrEqual(u, v)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns IsLessThanOrEqualUnder(ord, u, v) where ord is the basic wreath product ordering for the family of u and v (compatibility helper).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compatibility function for older GAP versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length(w) (for an associative word)
rubrics_metrics.description: For an associative word w, Length returns the number of letters in w.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works with powers and the identity: Length(a^17) etc. Examples show length computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentSumWord(w, gen)
rubrics_metrics.description: For associative word w and generator gen, returns number of times gen appears minus number of times its inverse appears; returns 0 if neither occurs. gen may be inverse of a generator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to compute total exponent sum of a generator in a word (examples show positive/negative results).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subword(w, from, to)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subword of w that begins at position from and ends at position to (indexing origin 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to extract substrings of associative words; example Subword(w,3,7).

rubrics_metrics.name: PositionWord(w, sub, from)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the position of the first occurrence of sub as a subword of w starting at position from; returns fail if none. Indexing origin 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalent to finding smallest i ≥ from with Subword(w,i,i+Length(sub)-1)=sub. Example shows finding positions and fail when not found.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubstitutedWord(w, from, to, by) / SubstitutedWord(w, sub, from, by)
rubrics_metrics.description: First form: replace subword from..to of w by by. Second form: replace first occurrence of sub in w starting at from by by; return fail if not found.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexing origin 1. Use for in-place-like replacements in words. Examples show replacing ranges and pattern-based replacement.

rubrics_metrics.name: EliminatedWord(w, gen, by)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the associative word obtained by replacing each occurrence of generator gen in w by by.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efficient special-case mapping when only one generator is substituted; examples show repeated replacement effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: NumberSyllables(w)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the number of syllables of associative word w (syllables are maximal powers of a single generator separated by different generators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in syllable-based operations; example NumberSyllables(w) for a^5*b*a^2*b^-4*a returns 5.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExponentSyllable(w, i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the exponent of the i-th syllable of the associative word w.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexing origin 1; example ExponentSyllable(w,3) returns 2 for given w.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorSyllable(w, i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the number (index) of the generator involved in the i-th syllable of w.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexing origin 1; useful to identify which generator a syllable uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubSyllables(w, from, to)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subword consisting of syllables from position from to to (indexing origin 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operates on syllable boundaries rather than letter positions; example SubSyllables(w,2,3) returns b*a^2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representations for associative words (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: GAP supports two internal representations for associative words: syllable representations (generator,exponent pairs) and letter representations (each letter represented by index number; negative numbers for inverses). By default letter representation is used unless syllable specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choice affects performance: syllable-based algorithms are faster on syllable reps, letter-based algorithms faster on letter reps. Example: creating pc groups benefits from syllable representation; free-group calculations often benefit from letter representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLetterAssocWordRep
rubrics_metrics.description: Representation predicate: a word in letter representation stores a list of generator/inverse numbers (see LetterRepAssocWord). Letter access is fast; syllable access is slow for such words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes internal layout; affects which operations are efficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLetterWordsFamily(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: a letter word family stores words by default in letter form. There are internal variants using integers or single bytes (byte form usable if <128 generators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when creating families where letter representation is desired; single-byte representation is more memory efficient when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBLetterAssocWordRep / IsWLetterAssocWordRep
rubrics_metrics.description: Subrepresentations of IsLetterAssocWordRep indicating whether the word is stored as a list of bytes (BLetter) or as a list of integers (WLetter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differ by memory/performance tradeoffs; chosen automatically depending on generator count.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBLetterWordsFamily / IsWLetterWordsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: Subcategories of IsLetterWordsFamily specifying the letter representation type to be used by default for a family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose to control default internal representation for words in a family.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSyllableAssocWordRep
rubrics_metrics.description: Representation predicate: a word in syllable representation stores generator/exponent pairs (as given by ExtRepOfObj). Syllable access is fast; letter access is slow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when working with syllable-level operations; performance implications noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSyllableWordsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: a syllable word family stores words by default in syllable form. Different syllable representations compress generator/exponent pairs into 8/16/32 bits or use integer pairs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internal mechanisms try to optimize memory; choose this family when syllable operations dominate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is16BitsFamily / Is32BitsFamily / IsInfBitsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories indicating the bit-size variant used for syllable representations or letter representations (internal packing choices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These control memory model; regardless of representation it is possible to convert between letter/syllable lists and back.

rubrics_metrics.name: LetterRepAssocWord(w[, gens])
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the letter representation of associative word w as a list of integers; inverses by negative numbers. If gens provided, generator numbers correspond to order in gens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For words stored in syllable form the letter representation must be computed. Use for low-level manipulations and interfacing with numeric representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: AssocWordByLetterRep(Fam, lrep[, gens])
rubrics_metrics.description: Takes a letter representation lrep and returns an associative word in family Fam corresponding to this letter representation. If gens given, numbers in lrep correspond to gens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows construction of associative words from low-level integer lists. Example shows how words are assembled from letter reps and retrieving LetterRepAssocWord(w^2).

rubrics_metrics.name: External representation for associative words (37.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: For associative word w = g1^e1 * g2^e2 * ... * gk^ek the external representation is [i1, e1, i2, e2, ..., ik, ek] where ij are generator indices. The empty list represents identity. Exponents may be negative for inverses; external rep is guaranteed freely reduced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExtRepOfObj returns this representation; it is useful to obtain syllable-style external reps even if internal representation is letter-based. Example: g1*g2*g2^-1*g1 has external rep [1,2].
